actionAdapters.when: 修改已确认的 Prefab 节点、组件或序列化引用

actionAdapters.entry: confirmed business UI Prefab TMP nodes and localization Key/FontMark authoritative mapping
actionAdapters.when: 仅在批量本地化绑定分支查出精确自有页面/目录节点、已有组件/值、variant/嵌套来源与权威Key/字体映射，不扩大到全工程，不以当前文案猜唯一Key

actionAdapters.entry: manage_prefabs modify_contents / manage_components set_property for confirmed TextLocalizing node mappings
actionAdapters.when: 按当前Provider Schema串行补唯一缺失TextLocalizing并保存真实m_LocalizingKeyName/m_LocalizingFontMark；已存在不重复挂，相同值跳过，遵守edit-settings目标/override/Stage保存门，不全工程FixMissingInPrefabs、不手写YAML

actionAdapters.entry: TextLocalizing.SetKeyName / SetFontMark / KeyName / FontMark + Nova.Localization.HasSupportedLanguage / HasText / GetText / SetLanguageSync / SetLanguageAsync
actionAdapters.when: 仅在已授权业务source实现动态绑定或本次完整请求语言集合Play观察；运行时setter不证明Prefab持久化，切换后核对实际语言文本/字体，测试偏好需恢复，不以compile替代全部请求语言验收（切换未指定集合最少两种）
UI注册源和已保存UISettings已冻结；全量scope=all/code/data，单文件sourcePath仅code/data；使用Plan/Execute/编译后Verify
获授权后验证目标页面的打开、关闭和查询行为

inputs.name: uiExportAction
inputs.constraint: 使用nova.project.ui.export，传scope与可选精确sourcePath；单文件all不支持，不拼接伪原子调用

inputs.name: confirmedPrefabOrSceneNodeSetAndAuthoritativeKeyFontMarkMapping
inputs.description: 批量本地化分支必需；从精确自有页面/目录读出节点与现有绑定，冻结映射、补组件、override/源范围，不猜Key、不覆盖无关节点

inputs.name: localizationSourceFontResourceDependencyAndRequestedLanguageSetAcceptance
inputs.description: 批量本地化分支必需；语言源/正式导出复用update-localization，字体Mark/资源/布局与完整请求Play语言集合明确：三种请求覆盖三种，明确单语言不扩大；只要求切换但未指定集合时冻结基准与目标至少两种，记录测试偏好及恢复路径

allow: confirmed existing target Prefab and serialized bindings
generated UI output required by this registration change
UI Action planned shared UITables, _configs and exact owned stale/counterpart deletions
confirmed project-owned UI node set missing TextLocalizing and explicit Key/FontMark fields through shared Unity MCP or selected edit-settings Operation
necessary authoritative localization source and formal output only through selected nova-project-update-localization and its exact write scope
deny: unknown layout or unrelated Prefab nodes
unrelated UI registration or generated output
manual edits to generated UI output
unconfirmed global TextLocalizing repair, inferred Key mapping, duplicate component, inherited source Apply/Unpack or unknown Stage/global dirty asset save
runtime TextLocalizing setters used as a substitute for persistent binding, handwritten RTL reversal or unconfirmed input/layout migration

requiredFor: ambiguous existing View, Prefab, UIGroup, registration source or layout scope
ambiguous batch node set, authoritative Key/FontMark, source/variant/override scope, font resource, test language or layout acceptance
delete, external write, credential use, Git commit or push
confirmation.rule: 确认目标页面、最小写入集和副作用；批量本地化冻结精确节点/原值/目标Key与字体、补组件、override/源范围、完整请求验证语言集合和偏好恢复（明确单语言不扩大，切换未指定集合时基准与目标至少两种）。可读事实由Agent取得，现有精确授权持续有效，目标或语义漂移后重新冻结。UI导出确认绑定Action PlanId及共享配置/UITables/删除范围；来源/语言/字体导出与Stage全局保存遵守所选Operation，不因批量扩大未确认写集。

evidence: 目标 View、Prefab 和注册源的局部 diff
Unity 保存的 Prefab 与序列化绑定
注册源确有变更时的 nova.project.ui.export Plan/Receipt/编译后Verify，来源Hash与完整选定输出一致
Unity 编译及任务必需的Play交互证据，compile不能代替明确要求的行为验收
批量本地化时逐节点权威映射、唯一组件、持久Key/FontMark与variant/嵌套override证据，必要源/正式导出/Config/字体资源消费完整链
批量本地化时实际入口完整请求语言集合逐项的文本/字体/布局/开关页验证及原语言偏好恢复，源码/Schema/未覆盖请求集合的截图不能标validated
测试对象/runner/meta/日志/偏好/动态字体及非目标序列化噪声清场与目标保存范围核对
